cat << 'EOF' > /tmp/ageval/disk-check.sh
#!/bin/bash

# Get the disk usage percentage of the root filesystem
# df / returns info for root. 
# awk extracts the percentage column (usually the 5th) and removes the '%' sign.
USAGE=$(df / | awk 'NR==2 {print $5}' | sed 's/%//')

if [ "$USAGE" -lt 90 ]; then
    echo "OK" > /tmp/ageval/disk-status.txt
else
    echo "WARNING" > /tmp/ageval/disk-status.txt
fi
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/ageval/disk-check.sh
